testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-quick-access-source/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:155:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts ✔ Given "fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd" and "fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/Assembly.oad" are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Print is not selected in either document's quick access customization menu ✔ When the user activates PartOne.opd and selects Print in its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print appears on the part's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user activates Assembly.oad ✔ Then Print is absent from the assembly's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user opens its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print is unchecked ✔ When the user returns to PartOne.opd ✔ Then Print is visible on the part's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user opens its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print is checked ✔ When the user selects Print again ✔ Then Print is removed from the part's quick access toolbar
